name: CommandList
purpose: Scrolling list of command groups and rows. Keeps the active row in view.

values.when: Populated list of groups and rows.

props.name: activeId
props.description: Active row; scrolled into view (block nearest).

keyboard: Active row scrolled into view. The keys that change the active row are on CommandPalette.
open: Group heading style is not recorded. py-3, min-h-0, flex-1, overflow-y-auto. The palette results list is B's ScrollArea use; kept here.
